post_title: What will the Brent crude oil front-month futures settlement price be on October 29, 2026?

question.title: What will the Brent crude oil front-month futures settlement price be on October 29, 2026?
question.description:
Brent crude is the leading global benchmark for seaborne crude oil, traded as a futures contract on ICE Futures Europe. The "front-month" (nearest-expiry) contract's daily settlement price is the most widely cited Brent price. In 2026, oil prices have been volatile and elevated: the front-month ICE Brent settled at a 2026 low of about $59.96 on January 7, 2026, hit a 2026 settlement high of about $118.35 on March 31, 2026, and traded in the low-to-mid $100s through October. On October 5, 2026 it settled at $100.32; on October 14, 2026 it settled at $106.06 (Dec 2026 contract); and intraday quotes on October 16, 2026 were around $105–$109.

Several forces are in play. The EIA's Short-Term Energy Outlook (released October 6, 2026) forecast Brent spot averaging about $96/bbl in 2026 and $84 in 2027. The IEA pledged to release the remaining 100 million barrels from an emergency intervention, and the G7 issued an October 2, 2026 statement on energy-market stability. Reports also indicated the US was weighing easing sanctions on vessels carrying Iranian, Russian, or Venezuelan oil, a potentially bearish factor. These supply-side developments, combined with ongoing geopolitical risk, create genuine two-sided uncertainty about where the front-month settlement will land on October 29, 2026.

The December 2026 Brent contract (ticker CBZ26) is the front-month contract during late October 2026; it expires at the end of October 2026. Barchart publishes the daily settlement ("Last") price for this contract on its historical-price page.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the official settlement price (in USD per barrel) of the ICE Brent Crude front-month futures contract on October 29, 2026, as reported on the Barchart historical-price page for the December 2026 contract (CBZ26): https://www.barchart.com/futures/quotes/CBZ26/price-history/historical . The resolution value is the "Last" (settlement) price shown in the row dated 10/29/2026. For example, a settlement of $104.37 resolves as 104.37. If Barchart does not report a settlement for that date, the question resolves to the ICE Brent front-month settlement for October 29, 2026 as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).
question.fine_print: The front-month contract is the nearest-to-expiry ICE Brent Crude futures contract; as of the resolution date this is the December 2026 contract (CBZ26). If October 29, 2026 is a trading holiday or the market does not settle that day, the most recent prior trading day's settlement in October 2026 is used. If the ICE Brent futures contract ceases to settle or the metric is no longer published anywhere, the question is annulled.
